assets.source: made for this game: every narrated sentence recorded by tools/voice_build.py with Kokoro-82M v1.0 (Apache-2.0, hexgrad) through sherpa-onnx (Apache-2.0)
assets.notes: one Ogg Opus file per sentence, named by the FNV-1a hash of the sentence; index.json lists them

assets.source: made for this game: Chapter III's models, built in Blender 5.2 from scripts in tools/blender/fort/ (written by Claude for this game, 2026-11-25) with the kit in tools/blender/kit.py. The barrels, barrel staves and chests are CC0 Poly Haven models (wooden_barrels_01, treasure_chest; polyhaven.com, CC0 1.0) reduced and colour-baked by tools/blender/bake_glb.py into tools/blender/props/
assets.notes: binary glTF, vertex colours only, no textures; loaded by loadGLB() in index.html

assets.source: made for this game: a saker of c. 1600 on a field carriage (node saker) and on a ship's truck carriage (node saker_truck), built in Blender 5.2 from tools/blender/fort/saker.py (written by Claude for this game, 2026-11-26) with the kit in tools/blender/kit.py; no third-party parts
assets.notes: 2,300 triangles (1,290 + 1,010), vertex colours only, no transparency; placed by fortSaker() in index.html

assets.source: made for this game: greyscale ground detail maps painted by Z-Image Turbo (Apache-2.0, Tongyi-MAI) through tools/textures/make_textures.py, made seamless and chosen by a local model (qwen3.8:27b)
assets.notes: 512 px JPEG luminance, mean 0.82; multiplied over vertex colours by groundMat()

assets.source: made for this game: Chapter II's models, built in Blender 5.2 from scripts in tools/blender/ch2/ (written by Claude for this game, 2026-11-25) with the kit in tools/blender/kit.py
assets.notes: binary glTF, vertex colours only, no textures; placed by placeModel() in index.html

assets.source: Poly Haven 'wooden_barrels_01' (polyhaven.com/a/wooden_barrels_01), reduced to a few hundred triangles with its colour baked into the vertices by tools/blender/bake_glb.py
assets.notes: binary glTF, vertex colours only; placed by placeModel() in index.html

assets.source: made for this game: a white-tailed deer. Picture painted by Z-Image Turbo (Apache-2.0, Tongyi-MAI), seed 11; turned into a mesh by TRELLIS.2 (MIT, Microsoft; DINOv3 image encoder under the Meta DINOv3 License, commercial use allowed) through ComfyUI; auto-rigged by SkinTokens/TokenRig (MIT, VAST-AI) and posed by E:/VN-Tools/skintokens/pose_quadruped.py; antlers cut away, reduced and colour-baked by tools/blender/bake_glb.py (2026-11-26)
assets.notes: binary glTF, vertex colours only, 1,500 triangles per pose (standing, grazing, startled); placed by addDeer() in index.html

assets.source: made for this game: a table with standing ends and a drawer, papers, an inkpot and a quill on it. Picture painted by Z-Image Turbo (Apache-2.0, Tongyi-MAI), seed 11, prompt "A seventeenth-century English wooden writing slope on a plain trestle table, with a few sheets of paper, an inkpot and a quill pen. Three-quarter view from slightly above, the whole object in frame with margin, every part visible, plain pure white studio background, soft even lighting, photoreal product photo."; turned into a mesh by TRELLIS.2 (MIT, Microsoft; DINOv3 image encoder under the Meta DINOv3 License, commercial use allowed) through ComfyUI; reduced and colour-baked by tools/blender/bake_glb.py (--tris 2500 --height 4.5 --voxel 0.035) (2026-11-27)
assets.notes: binary glTF, vertex colours only, 2,491 triangles, 249 KB; placed by presTable() in index.html (Chapters VI and VII) at scale 1.05, and under the four accounts in Chapter VII

assets.source: made for this game: a small bronze bell hung from a beam on two posts with feet. Picture painted by Z-Image Turbo (Apache-2.0, Tongyi-MAI), seed 11, prompt "A small bronze bell hanging from a simple wooden frame of two posts and a crossbar, seventeenth century. Three-quarter view from slightly above, the whole object in frame with margin, every part visible, plain pure white studio background, soft even lighting, photoreal product photo."; turned into a mesh by TRELLIS.2 (MIT, Microsoft; DINOv3 image encoder under the Meta DINOv3 License, commercial use allowed) through ComfyUI; reduced and colour-baked by tools/blender/bake_glb.py (--tris 2500 --height 6) (2026-11-27)
assets.notes: binary glTF, vertex colours only, 2,495 triangles, 215 KB; placed by starveBell() in index.html (Chapter VII, 23 May 1610)

assets.source: made for this game: an empty three-legged iron cooking pot with two ears. Picture painted by Z-Image Turbo (Apache-2.0, Tongyi-MAI), seed 7, prompt "A three-legged cast-iron cooking pot of the early 1600s with a bail handle, plain black iron, empty. Three-quarter view from slightly above, the whole object in frame with margin, every part visible, plain pure white studio background, soft even lighting, photoreal product photo."; turned into a mesh by TRELLIS.2 (MIT, Microsoft; DINOv3 image encoder under the Meta DINOv3 License, commercial use allowed) through ComfyUI; reduced and colour-baked by tools/blender/bake_glb.py (--tris 2000 --height 0.85) (2026-11-27)
assets.notes: binary glTF, vertex colours only, 1,999 triangles, 167 KB; placed by starveHearth() in index.html (Chapter VII, the winter) at scale 1.1, and as the cook's kettle on the ship in Chapter I (buildCabins, at 1.45 x K)

assets.source: made for this game: a stingray lying flat, its tail out behind. Picture painted by Z-Image Turbo (Apache-2.0, Tongyi-MAI), seed 7, prompt "A single brown Atlantic stingray lying flat, a broad diamond-shaped body and a long thin whip-like tail with a small spine on it, seen from above at an angle. Three-quarter view from slightly above, the whole object in frame with margin, every part visible, plain pure white studio background, soft even lighting, photoreal product photo."; turned into a mesh by TRELLIS.2 (MIT, Microsoft; DINOv3 image encoder under the Meta DINOv3 License, commercial use allowed) through ComfyUI; reduced and colour-baked by tools/blender/bake_glb.py (--tris 1500 --height 1.1) (2026-11-27)
assets.notes: binary glTF, vertex colours only, 1,499 triangles, 131 KB; placed in the Bay scene of Chapter VI (the ray that stung Smith), flattened to 0.4 of its height

assets.source: made for this game: a brass basin with a ewer standing in it, one of the Company's presents to Powhatan. Picture painted by Z-Image Turbo (Apache-2.0, Tongyi-MAI), seed 11, prompt "An early seventeenth-century English brass basin, wide and shallow, with a tall brass ewer standing in it, plain hammered metal. Three-quarter view from slightly above, the whole object in frame with margin, every part visible, plain pure white studio background, soft even lighting, photoreal product photo."; turned into a mesh by TRELLIS.2 (MIT, Microsoft; DINOv3 image encoder under the Meta DINOv3 License, commercial use allowed) through ComfyUI; reduced and colour-baked by tools/blender/bake_glb.py (--tris 2500 --height 1.08 --voxel 0.01) (2026-11-27)
assets.notes: binary glTF, vertex colours only, 2,500 triangles, 250 KB; spawned in PRES_CROWN() in index.html (Chapter VI, the crowning)

assets.source: made for this game: a white-tailed doe lying dead on her side, the venison Thomas Savage brought down from Powhatan. Picture painted by Z-Image Turbo (Apache-2.0, Tongyi-MAI), seed 7, prompt "A dead white-tailed deer doe lying on her side on the ground, her four legs bound together with a cord, eyes closed, no blood and no wounds, brown summer coat with a white belly. Full body three-quarter view from slightly above showing the head, the legs and the tail, plain pure white background, photoreal, studio lighting."; turned into a mesh by TRELLIS.2 (MIT, Microsoft; DINOv3 image encoder under the Meta DINOv3 License, commercial use allowed) through ComfyUI; reduced and colour-baked by tools/blender/bake_glb.py (--tris 2000 --height 2.0 --voxel 0.025) (2026-11-27)
assets.notes: binary glTF, vertex colours only, 2,000 triangles, 200 KB; placed in the fort scene of Chapter VII (early October 1609) by the gate
